fixes: slides 5-6: delete them, or add verified claims for the IWC Ingenieur and Pasha facts to research.json, each from two outlets, and cite the outlets. Drop 'another steel sports design' unless it is sourced.
slide 3: shorten the text to one line, e.g. 'Patek Philippe launches the Nautilus.', and move the block clear of the dial, or use a text-only slide with the photo credit moved to the caption.
caption.json: remove the gaps line that says the IWC and Pasha facts were dropped, so the caption matches the slides. Add the new claim IDs if you keep slides 5-6.
slide 4: reword the tag line and body so it does not read as filler. The Gear Patrol quote is fine as long as it stays attributed.
verdict.reason: The Genta story is a good hook, but two beats (IWC Ingenieur 1976, Pasha 1985) have no verified claims behind them, and the Nautilus photo slide has text over the dial. Fix the sourcing and that layout, then resubmit.
